chapter: The 1920s road: dance style and management
title: Black entertainment in a wander; the tomato factory job
summary: With salaries cut and his refusal to work for less, he sorted and delivered tomatoes in New York about 1947-49.

story.theme_name: Making a living: hard times, day jobs and scarce work
story.community_name: Day jobs: musicians working outside music

blocks.x: What was happening about this time in terms of black entertainment?
In this country. You were sort of in the center of it -- not only were you in the center of it but you were creating it. What was happening, what was black entertainment like?

I wonder what we should do with them. It was in a wander, man. Black entertainment was in a wander because of the fact that the axe that I guess that they had, were they too much in demand or not enough in demand. And they didn't know what to do with them. Because when they would cut salaries and I refused to work so I laid off for quite a while because I refused to work, they cut the salary to the extent of how will I get it back to where it was and how can I work for $500 if I'm $1000 act. So I'd rather do something else. So I did.
I worked at a tomato place wherethey packed tomatoes. I used

to pick out rotten tomatoes from good tomatoes. I'd pick out good tomatoes from rotten tomatoes at their run, you pick them out and put them in there. You pick them out, separate them -- all the bad tomatoes would go out there and all the good tomatoes over here. I did that. Then I used to drive a delivery truck for the purpose of delivering these packages of tomatoes. I did that between this time.
That was in 1948 or '49. I'd say between '47 and '49.
But in those years you chose not to be in the entertainment world.
I chose not -- not to be in the entertainment world, right. I was in it but I was out at the same time. I'm

ready for it when it comes up like it should. But as long as they're ain't going to be nothing to it, I ain't going to bother with it. I'm just going to have a paycheck coming in at the end of the month or the end of the week to take care of the expenses.
